title: dianthus requienii subsp. arragonensis
intro: Dianthus requienii subsp. arragonensis, commonly known as the Fragrant Pink or Pink Fragrant Pink, is a subspecies of the Dianthus requienii plant, a type of flowering plant in the carnation family. This plant is known for its fragrant pink flowers and is used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus requienii subsp. arragonensis include soothing coughs, relieving congestion, and calming the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
